item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Enforce five-minute expiry and 100-record capacity.","mechanism":"Monotonic expiry controls freshness; expired-first, then least-recently-used eviction bounds the cache.","implementation":"Admit only allowlisted public fields from public sources. Set expiry at fetch start plus 300 seconds; atomically evict before insertion.","check":"With a fake clock, verify expiry at 300 seconds, including during outages. Insert 101 keys; assert at most 100 records.","risk":"Slow fetches shorten usable lifetime; discard responses already expired."},{"action":"Return an explicit error when the source times out.","mechanism":"A fixed source deadline prevents indefinite waiting; failures never renew records or replace them with cached errors.","implementation":"Set a configurable fetch deadline. On timeout, cancel retrieval and return HTTP 503 with code source_timeout. Remove any expired entry; preserve unexpired entries.","check":"Simulate a hanging source. Verify timely 503, unchanged expiration timestamps, expired-entry removal, and no error-record insertion.","risk":"Cancellation must also stop underlying network work."},{"action":"Merge concurrent misses for the same record.","mechanism":"One in-flight fetch per key prevents duplicate source requests; bounded admission limits outage-related request buildup.","implementation":"Maintain an in-flight promise map capped at a configured size. Join existing fetches; reject excess distinct misses with 503 cache_busy. Remove promises on completion.","check":"Send concurrent requests for one missing key: observe one source call. Force timeout; verify shared errors and an empty promise map.","risk":"Bound waiters too; shared fetches otherwise accumulate callers."},{"action":"Temporarily stop source calls after repeated failures.","mechanism":"A circuit breaker makes sustained outages explicit while still serving cached records whose original expiry has not passed.","implementation":"After a configured consecutive-failure threshold, reject misses with 503 source_unavailable during cooldown. Then allow one probe; never extend TTL or suspend eviction.","check":"Force the threshold failures; verify no source calls during cooldown, expired-record eviction, one recovery probe, and resumed fetching after success.","risk":"Long cooldowns delay recovery; short cooldowns repeatedly probe outages."}],"abstention_reason":""}
